gloss.en: allesbinder — Dutch instant sauce thickener; cornflour slaked in water does the same job
bakgember — candied (crystallised) ginger sold for baking
basterdsuiker — Dutch fine moist sugar; light soft brown sugar is the closest match
bavette — flat pasta between linguine and tagliatelle; linguine works
boemboe — Indonesian spice paste (Conimex-style sachet), here the peanut-satay one
bruine bonen — Dutch brown beans; borlotti or pinto beans are the closest
daun salam — Indonesian bay leaf (from the toko); an ordinary bay leaf is the usual stand-in
dried French herb mix (chervil, chives, tarragon, parsley)
Indonesian peanut sauce for gado-gado
Dutch spice mix for minced meat (nutmeg, pepper, coriander)
diced beef for hachee, the Dutch beef-and-onion stew
thick fresh Chinese egg noodles
kaas — Gouda; mild (jong), mature (belegen) or extra mature (oud)
kapucijners — Dutch tinned marrowfat (grey) peas
Indonesian salty soy sauce; light soy sauce works too
Indonesian sweet soy sauce
kipkarbonade — bone-in chicken thigh cutlet
komijn / djinten — ground cumin (djinten is the Indonesian toko name)
Indonesian side dishes: prawn crackers, atjar (sweet-sour pickled vegetables) and seroendeng (spiced fried coconut)
kruidenbouillon — Dutch vegetable-and-herb stock cube
Dutch hard cheese with garlic and herbs
laos — galangal, dried and ground (fresh slices at Asian shops)
Surinamese-style curry powder (blend of turmeric, coriander, cumin)
very young, mild Dutch cheese (May cheese) — a young Gouda works
Dutch brand of full-fat cream cheese; Philadelphia is the nearest match

nl.one: olie en boter om in te bakken

nl: boter en olie om in te bakken

gloss.en: Dutch spiced breakfast cake — a soft, dark gingerbread-style loaf
Dutch smoked processed cheese, sold as a sausage-shaped log
wafer-thin Dutch smoked beef — bresaola is the closest match
Dutch smoked sausage (rookworst) — a smoked pork ring or Polish kielbasa works
sambal badjak — Indonesian fried chilli paste, sweeter and milder than sambal oelek
sambal oelek — Indonesian crushed chilli paste
santen — Indonesian coconut cream, sold as a block or a carton
soepgroenten — Dutch pre-cut soup vegetable mix (leek, carrot, celeriac, cauliflower)
sukadelappen — Dutch braising beef (feather blade / chuck), for slow stews
trassi — Indonesian fermented shrimp paste (terasi / belacan)
vadouvan — French-Indian curry spice blend with shallot and garlic
winterpeen — large Dutch winter carrot; any big carrot will do
Zaanse mosterd — coarse Dutch mustard from the Zaan region; wholegrain mustard works
zalmsnippers — Dutch pack of smoked salmon offcuts
zure bom — a whole large pickled cucumber (Dutch deli jar)
